verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Datadog's core product. Community posts instead describe it as a hosted service that would have to be replaced with other tooling to self-host, and say it has no local option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
